tools.name: search_stores
tools.title: Search stores
tools.description: Search the RushOrder PH marketplace for live stores by name, optionally filtered by service type (food, groceries, pharmacy, services).

query.description: Text to match against the store name.

service_type.description: Service type filter, e.g. food, groceries, pharmacy or services.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: list_store_products
tools.title: List store products
tools.description: List the published products of one RushOrder PH store, including price, stock and availability.

store_id.description: The store's UUID, as returned by search_stores.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.title: List my orders
tools.description: List the signed-in user's RushOrder PH orders, newest first, with status, totals and payment state.

status.description: Optional status filter: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready, picked_up, delivered or cancelled.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order details
tools.description: Fetch one RushOrder PH order the signed-in user can access, including its line items and delivery status.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List my notifications
tools.description: List the signed-in user's RushOrder PH notifications, newest first.

unread_only.description: When true, return only unread notifications.

limit.description: Maximum number of notifications to return (default 20, max 50).
